method: Exact declaration-name regex, one hit per symbol per flattened file; name matches do not establish vendor identity or audited-code equivalence. Project count is distinct first path component. Only current .flat directories, not .flat@timestamp snapshots. Comments are not parsed as Solidity, and free functions/types/renamed contracts are not counted.
